name: io.github.agorapassadoagora-debug/aipm
title: AI Process Manager (AIPM)
description: Structured Windows state for AI agents - processes, windows, console text and UI Automation trees, as compact JSON over loopback. ~94-98% fewer perception tokens per action than screenshots, measured. Read-only by default; action tier is opt-in per application. Nothing leaves the machine.
